headline: Building empirical systems that make economic evidence traceable, testable, and resistant to overstatement.
subheadline: My work focuses on international and development economics, spanning product-level trade, Vietnamese firm-level data, panel econometrics, predictive modeling, and reproducible research infrastructure.
statement: I work from economic questions toward auditable evidence: constructing datasets, testing econometric designs, evaluating predictive systems, and reporting completed results within the limits supported by the data.
